title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 36,811 Official Dossiers Across 34 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 36,811 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 760 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 34 active jurisdictions: United States (15,100), United Kingdom (2,322), Canada (5,351), European Union (3,101), United Nations (6,923), Ireland (159), Australia (1,149), International (897), Austria (155), Switzerland (181), Finland (66), France (288), South Korea (66), Norway (71), Italy (57), Philippines (53), Poland (42), South Africa (46), India (11), Belgium (25), Brazil (84), Japan (55), Netherlands (31), Russia (24), Sweden (47), China (26), Czechia (36), Germany (148), Denmark (32), Estonia (16), Spain (35), Israel (128), Portugal (4), Singapore (82).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, and the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt).
